exposure: homogenized and lyophilized amniotic membrane (hAMpe) dressings
cohort: Sixteen ambulatory patients with granulation-based diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) after proper debridement were included in the study.
finding: The median days to healing was 96 days, with wounds achieving 41% closure at 3 weeks, 68.2% at 6 weeks, and 100% at 12 weeks, at an average closure velocity of 1.04% per day.
followup_time: up to 12 weeks (or 96 days for healing)
